connector.name: Sugra API
connector.registryDescription: Gateway between LLM agents and world data through eight tools and a bundled endpoint catalog.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.sugra.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package sugra-api-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.sugra. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SUGRA_API_KEY
env.description: Your Sugra API key. Get one free at https://app.sugra.ai/settings/billing (Free tier: 50 req/day).
